name: live-order-tracking-static-vanilla-js
description: On-Demand Delivery Checkout, Zone Validation & Live Tracker using Static HTML + Vanilla JavaScript (ES Modules) and modern Google Maps Platform APIs.

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { const required = ['index.html', 'app.js', 'styles.css', 'server.mjs']; for (const file of required) { if (!fs.existsSync(file)) throw new Error('Missing required asset: ' + file); } console.log('Verified static-vanilla-js build assets.'); })"
